currentPhase: Live Monitoring Phase 1 done + PKT timezone fix
currentStep: Delivery Trail (Phase 1) complete. PKT timezone utility created. Drag fix, column rename, delivery-trail query restructured to use delivered_at in PKT range. LiveDeliveryTrail now uses dynamic import (ssr: false) to fix SSR crash.
keyDecisions: Live Monitoring is a view on /map page, not a separate page. Panel uses fixed positioning with z-[9999] to stay above Leaflet elements.

PKT timezone utility (src/lib/pkt.ts) created as single source of truth for all Pakistan timezone date/datetime operations. All future timestamp captures and filters should use pktToday() / pktDayRange() / pktCurrentMonth().

Delivery trail API queries by delivered_at in PKT date range (not issued_at assignment date). issued_at tracks when assignment was created; delivered_at tracks actual delivery time — live monitoring cares about the latter.
LiveDeliveryTrail uses dynamic(() => import(...), { ssr: false }) — same pattern as StaffMap — because react-leaflet references window during import.
timestamptz column storage remains UTC — only filter computations and date-only columns changed to PKT. Zero risk to existing data.
